summary: Vocabulary and names left by the rename, none wrong: the doctor `stray:` line says "is not a selected provider (from --harness or --no-harness)" while the help of the same command says harness, SkillsError::InvalidProvider says "unknown provider", and three bound tests are spelt atip_provideroption_05/09/10_..._harnesss_... (a doubled s from the bulk rename; they are the case names the evidence binds, so a rename means a re-bind).
